name: Yagasaki Chihaya
source: Even though she joins the protagonist's family as his mother-in-law, she is only in common law marriage with his father. Because she is weak to pushing and always tries to get the protagonist to admit her as mother, she accepts everything he says while not knowing he has secret desire for her.
